methods.cash_definition: Cash and balances due from depository institutions, not Fed reserves alone
methods.sample: Independent of Question 1 income/expense/ROA availability; charter_type=200
methods.stock_treatment: No YTD conversion, annualization or winsorization; no clipping
methods.differences: Adjacent calendar quarters only; negative changes retained
methods.covariance: Calendar-quarter Bartlett HAC4 with n/(n-5) correction
methods.test: Sum of four slopes=0; two-sided asymptotic normal; nominal alpha=.05; no multiplicity adjustment
methods.fit_statistics: In-sample R-squared and adjusted R-squared; constant outcomes unavailable
methods.figure: Equal-bank mean among eligible banks' available level records; composition varies by quarter
